headline_hook: Anthropic Races Past $900B While Hackers Target Your CLAUDE.md
preview_topics: the Claude Code trick power users swear by

pick_of_the_day.thesis: The files we created to make AI agents useful — CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules — are becoming the newest supply chain attack surface, and most teams have zero review process for them because they look like harmless documentation.

model_literacy.relevance: Today's research paper formalizes how LLM agents progressively forget requirements during complex code generation — directly relevant as readers adopt the multi-agent workflows featured in this issue.

items.title: The One Claude Code Setting That Changes Everything
items.angle: Boris Cherny's most-liked tip ever: auto mode enables multi-clauding workflows that most power users haven't discovered yet.
items.key_fact: 3,826 likes — his highest-engagement Claude Code tip to date

items.title: GPT-5.5 Pro Turns Out to Be a Ruthless Fact-Checker
items.angle: Ethan Mollick stress-tested GPT-5.5 Pro on entire book chapters and found it hunts down references with surprising accuracy.
items.key_fact: Can fact-check full chapters, though it tends to over-nuance edge cases

items.title: The 'Please Save Me Money' Prompt That Actually Works
items.angle: Budget-conscious developers discovered that literally asking Claude to reduce costs produces measurably cheaper outputs.
items.key_fact: 1,023 likes from a single cost-optimization trick

items.title: The Self-Improving Codex Prompt Now Mines Your Session History
items.angle: A refined meta-prompt that auto-generates skills and subagents from your Codex session patterns — the prompt engineering community iterating in public.
items.key_fact: 2,216 likes; evolved overnight from yesterday's viral version

items.title: Anthropic Publishes Its Internal Claude Code Playbook
items.angle: The official engineering workflow guide covers context files, hooks, subagents, and custom commands — the gap between stock and tuned setups is enormous.
items.key_fact: Free guide more useful than paid Claude Code courses

items.title: Claude Is Writing Illustrated Home Repair Manuals Now
items.angle: Felix Rieseberg uses Claude to generate problem-specific illustrated instruction manuals for real-world home engineering — a multimodal use case beyond coding.
items.key_fact: Generates custom diagrams and step-by-step instructions for physical problems

items.title: Hackers Are Submitting Malicious CLAUDE.md Files to Popular Repos
items.angle: Socket Security documents a new supply chain attack vector — poisoned .cursorrules and CLAUDE.md files in PRs that hijack AI coding agents. The agent-era equivalent of dependency confusion.
items.key_fact: Active attacks targeting popular AI agent repositories right now

items.title: Anthropic Closes $30B Round at $900B+, Surpassing OpenAI
items.angle: Anthropic reportedly passes OpenAI's $852B valuation to become the world's most valuable AI startup — a 2.4x jump in three months.
items.key_fact: $900B+ valuation, up from ~$375B three months ago

items.title: Memory Now Eats Two-Thirds of AI Chip Costs
items.angle: Epoch AI data reveals a structural shift in chip economics — memory dominates component costs, explaining why memory-efficient architectures are suddenly everyone's priority.
items.key_fact: Memory share of AI chip costs approaching 66%

items.title: June's Model Calendar: Gemini 3.5, GPT 5.6, Sonnet 4.7
items.angle: A roadmap of expected June releases for teams deciding when to lock model versions — the density suggests a coordinated competitive sprint.
items.key_fact: At least four major model releases expected in a single month

items.title: YC Publishes Its AI Startup Wishlist for Summer 2026
items.angle: Y Combinator's new RFS telegraphs where the most influential accelerator is placing bets — a signal for founders and investors alike.
items.key_fact: Public list of million-dollar AI startup ideas YC wants to fund

items.title: DeepSeek Reasonix: A Coding Agent That Leads With Price
items.angle: DeepSeek launches a native coding agent optimized for caching efficiency — positioning directly against Claude Code and Codex on cost.
items.key_fact: High caching hit rates designed to undercut competitor pricing

items.title: Coral Replaces MCP Tool Glue With a Single SQL Interface
items.angle: Query APIs, files, and data sources with SQL instead of wiring up individual MCP tools — benchmarks show 20% more accurate and 2x cheaper.
items.key_fact: 20% accuracy gain and 2x cost reduction vs. direct MCP providers

items.title: Obsidian Gets Agent Skills — and 32K Stars Agree
items.angle: Kepano ships agent skills that teach AI to work with Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, and CLI inside Obsidian — the knowledge-management-meets-agents workflow people have been waiting for.
items.key_fact: 32,853 GitHub stars, fastest-trending AI repo this week

items.title: Meituan Open-Sources a SOTA Talking-Avatar Model Under MIT
items.angle: LongCat Video Avatar 1.5 may be the best open-source video avatar model yet — and the MIT license means commercial use is unrestricted.

items.title: New Paper: Your Coding Agent Forgets Requirements Mid-Task
items.angle: Researchers formalize 'constraint decay' — the progressive loss of requirements during multi-file code generation — and it explains a failure mode every agent user has felt.
items.key_fact: LLM agents systematically degrade on backend code as complexity increases
